scope: Fresh source review of all 65 reviewed careers before this validation release; official entry proxy data for those 64 exact occupations plus physician and dentist.
sourceReferencePeriod: May 2025 wages (latest public OEWS release found)

officialBLSDownloadAttempt.result: HTTP 403 from command environment; compared primary federal O*NET presentation and official state TWC presentation instead. Both share upstream OEWS data.

twcMethodology.publisher: Texas Workforce Commission / Labor Market Information
twcMethodology.title: 2025 Annual MSA Wages · Entry wage proxy
twcMethodology.entryDefinition: Mean wage of the lowest-paid one-third of workers in the selected occupation and location. It is an entry wage proxy, not observed pay by years of experience.
twcMethodology.experiencedDefinition: Mean wage of the upper-paid two-thirds; not a measured 5-, 10-, or 20-year salary.
twcMethodology.population: Wage and salary employees; self-employed workers excluded.
twcMethodology.exclusionReason: SOC 27-1019 covers broader artist occupations, not tattoo-specific earnings.
twcMethodology.suppressionRule: Zero or absent regional figures mean unavailable; never use them as a zero salary.

findings: All 64 exact-occupation employee wage anchors match the current O*NET tables. Psychiatric aide uses Dallas because Austin is absent.

TWC provides an official lower-third entry wage proxy for 64 exact occupations, including the Dallas psychiatric-aide fallback. Existing generic entry multipliers differ materially for several occupations.
No reviewed source supports assigning generic occupation-family multipliers to actual 5-,10-,20-year earnings. Keep those labeled illustrative scenarios.
Tattoo earnings should be a low-confidence illustrative business/contractor scenario; do not interpret five salary-bearing postings as representative employee earnings.
Physician and dentist were omitted from the reviewed catalog; neither is excluded by student interests or an assessment result.

records.population: Wage and salary employees; excludes self-employed workers
records.methodCaveat: Source transcription/freshness check. Not independent statistical validation and not a measured experience-year wage series.
